title: Insured-Transition Credit on Self-Pay Visit Package Installments
content:
**Financial counseling note — Self-Pay Visit Package installments.** The insured-transition credit on a past-due installment is **$25.00** where the patient holds an Insured Plan of Care in active status opened on or after the freeze start date of the package, **$10.00** where the patient holds one in intake status opened on or after that freeze start date, and none otherwise. The credit is taken off the scheduled share of the installment being collected.

**Records read**

- The freeze start date recorded on the Self-Pay Visit Package. A package that has never been frozen has no freeze start date, and no credit arises.
- The status and opened date of the patient's Insured Plan of Care.

**Decision table**

| Insured Plan of Care held by the patient | Opened on or after the package's freeze start date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| in active status | Yes | $25.00 |
| in intake status (and none in active status meeting the date) | Yes | $10.00 |
| in active or intake status | No — opened before the freeze start date | none |
| on hold, discharged or closed | — | none |
| none | — | none |

**Dated cases (hypothetical)**

| Freeze start date | Plan status | Plan opened | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | active | 10 March | $25.00 — opened on the freeze start date counts |
| 10 March | active | 9 March | none |
| 10 March | intake | 2 April | $10.00 |
| no freeze on record | active | 2 April | none |
